segments.name: Services
segments.description: Provides cash management, trade and working capital financing services to corporate and institutional clients globally.
segments.evidence: Services increased 10%, driven by demand in TTS for working capital loans as well as export and agency finance.

segments.name: Markets
segments.description: Serves institutional clients with trading, financing and market-making across fixed income and other spread products.
segments.evidence: Markets increased 25%, primarily driven by asset-backed financing and commercial warehouse lending in Spread Products.

segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Delivers lending, capital markets and merger and acquisition advisory services to corporate and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: Citi aims to establish relationships with these clients whose needs encompass multiple products, including cash management and trade services, foreign exchange, lending, capital markets and M&A advisory.

segments.name: Wealth
segments.description: Provides wealth management, lending and investment services to affluent and high-net-worth clients.
segments.evidence: Wealth increased 1%, with growth in margin lending primarily offset by the transfers of certain relationships and associated mortgage loans to USPB from Wealth .

segments.name: U.S. Personal Banking
segments.description: Offers credit cards, retail banking and lending products to U.S. consumers and retail clients.
segments.evidence: USPB increased 5%, driven by growth in Retail Banking, largely due to transfers of certain relationships and associated mortgage loans to USPB from Wealth , as well as growth in Branded Cards.

revenueModel.text: Corporate, institutional and retail clients pay Citi for banking products and services including cash management, trade services, foreign exchange, lending, capital markets and M&A advisory.
revenueModel.evidence: Citi aims to establish relationships with these clients whose needs encompass multiple products, including cash management and trade services, foreign exchange, lending, capital markets and M&A advisory.
